al.name: Alabama (statewide)
al.bounds: Every Alabama waterfowl season is statewide. The Mobile-Tensaw Delta Waterfowl Management Zone changes the days and hours only (amber on the map).

seasonsNote: Every season is statewide. In the Mobile-Tensaw Delta zone, ducks, coots, mergansers and geese are closed on Mondays and Tuesdays and shooting ends at 1 p.m. on other days (except the early teal and goose seasons).

seasons.label: Geese — September
seasons.note: The goose season runs Sept 5 – Oct 4, Oct 17–31, Nov 27–28 and Dec 5 – Jan 31.

seasons.label: Dark geese — regular
seasons.note: Canada and white-fronted geese and brant.

seasons.label: Veterans and active military waterfowl days

bags.detail: Six ducks, inside which the limits below apply. Possession three times the daily limit (federal rule).
Dark geese (Canada, white-fronted, brant) in aggregate.
Dark geese (Canada, white-fronted, brant) in aggregate.
Light geese (snow, blue, Ross’s) in aggregate.
Regular hours, limits, arms and ammunition. Up to 2 youths (under 16) per adult supervisor 21+; one firearm per youth.

duckSublimits.note: their own limit; no more than 2 hooded

rules.d: One-half hour before sunrise to sunset, except the Mobile-Tensaw Delta zone (to 1 p.m., Wednesday – Sunday) and Corps of Engineers lands and waters in Pickens, Greene and Sumter counties (hours on the ACOE permit).

Closed to waterfowl hunting on Mondays and Tuesdays; Wednesday – Sunday shooting from ½ hour before sunrise to 1:00 p.m. (early teal and goose seasons: every day to sunset). Big Bateau Bay and Bay Grass: no gas-powered motors from the second Saturday in November to the second Saturday in February. Amber on the map.

No hunting, and no gas-powered motors from the second Saturday in November to the second Saturday in February, inside I-10, the western channel of the Apalachee River (as signed) and US 90. Red on the map (an approximate circle).
Bows, crossbows, or shotguns 10 gauge or smaller plugged to 3 shells, with T-size steel or smaller or other approved non-toxic shot. Possessing lead shot while hunting waterfowl is illegal.

rules.t: Youth, veteran and active military days

rules.d: Leave the head or one fully feathered wing on until you get home, and tag birds left with anyone else (federal rules).

licences.d: Resident annual all-game $35.30 or small game $23.40; non-resident small game $134.10 (10-day $81.70, 3-day $59.10).

geometryNote: Geometry: ADCNR WMAs and special opportunity areas; DCNR boat ramps; the Mobile-Tensaw Delta zone on OpenStreetMap’s US 90, I-10, US 98, AL 225 and the CSX railroad, with USGS NHD’s Mobile River line standing in for the river’s west bank (approximate there); USGS NHD (water; streams from the NHD small-scale layer) and GNIS; USFWS (refuge units; NWI marsh); NOAA CO-OPS (tides); Census TIGER (outline, county subdivisions, borders). One statewide zone.
